description: Save a URL to the KnowMan Inbox or directly to the Knowledge Base. Pass trust:'internal' when the link is the user's own knowledge (their company docs, their own writing) rather than an outside article.

location.description: Save into the Inbox or directly into the Knowledge Base.

note.description: Optional note to attach to the saved item.

trust.description: Mark the saved link as the user's own knowledge ('internal' — their company docs, their own posts) rather than an outside article ('external', the default).
